intro: Popular Story Mode mods for GTA V Enhanced (GTA5_Enhanced.exe). Legacy mods don't automatically work here: use builds marked Enhanced. Script Hook V comes first, and every mod that needs it waits for a Script Hook V update after each patch. Story Mode only: never launch GTA Online with mods installed.

mods.name: Script Hook V + Native Trainer
mods.summary: Alexander Blade's script loader. Nearly every script and trainer needs it, and each game patch breaks it until it's updated.
mods.note: Copy ScriptHookV.dll and the bundled ASI loader (dinput8.dll) next to GTA5_Enhanced.exe. It closes the game if you go into GTA Online.

mods.name: DirectStorageFix
mods.summary: Lets scripts write their own config, log and save files on Enhanced again when DirectStorage is on.

mods.name: OpenRPF
mods.summary: Enhanced's equivalent of OpenIV.asi: loads replacement and add-on files from a separate mods folder.
mods.note: OpenIV itself doesn't support Enhanced. Keep edits in the mods folder so a Steam verify restores the originals.

mods.name: Script Hook V .NET Enhanced
mods.summary: Runs .NET (C#) scripts on Enhanced as well as Legacy. Most C# mods ported to Enhanced need it.
mods.note: Install Microsoft .NET Framework 4.8 first. It also runs on Legacy, so scripts can target both editions.

mods.name: Simple Mods Loader
mods.summary: Loads custom files from a mods folder as loose files or RPFs, and adjusts heap and packfile limits for you.

mods.name: Simple Trainer
mods.summary: Trainer with an Enhanced build: spawn vehicles and peds, change weather and time, and teleport.
mods.note: Enhanced keeps its settings in %APPDATA%\trainerv\enhanced, separate from Legacy.

mods.name: Menyoo 2.0
mods.summary: Trainer and map editor with Enhanced support: place objects, edit outfits and build scenes.
mods.note: Its page lists OpenRPF's ASI loader and, on Windows 11, DirectStorageFix as requirements.

mods.name: Rampage Trainer
mods.summary: Story Mode trainer with many vehicle, weapon, world and player options. Needs the latest Script Hook V.
mods.note: On Enhanced, install DirectStorageFix if its settings don't save.

mods.name: Packfile Limit Adjuster Enhanced
mods.summary: Packfile Limit Adjuster rebuilt for Enhanced: fixes crashes from installing a large number of RPF archives.

mods.name: Modkit Limit Adjuster Enhanced
mods.summary: Raises the vehicle modkit limit (2048 by default) so tuning parts on add-on cars work.

mods.name: fwBoxStreamer + DecalsPatch Enhanced
mods.summary: Raises Enhanced's decal limit (bullet holes, blood, tire marks) so heavy action runs smoother and crashes less.

mods.name: Straight To Story Mode
mods.summary: Skips the legal and splash screens and Enhanced's landing page, loading straight into Story Mode.

mods.name: Enable All Interiors
mods.summary: Opens interiors across the map in Story Mode, replacing older mods such as Open All Interiors.
